s.d: literally: to go through; hence: = process by which a river or passageway takes a twisting or spiraling course from one place to another
literally: to go around; hence: = state in which objects are located all around a person or animal
literally: to go around; hence: = action by which groups of humans or animals take position all around an individual, a group, or an object
literally: to cause to surround; hence: = causative action by which humans cause a construction to be all around an object
literally: to surround; hence: = action by which humans take their place around a table
s.g: to sit down around the table

s.d: literally: to surround; hence: = state in which humans remain constantly associated with and held responsible for past deeds
s.g: to surround > to be a constant witness

s.d: literally: to be surrounded; hence: = state in which the bottom and the sides of an object are tightly fixed in a mold that keeps it in its place
literally: (a measuring cord of a certain length) surrounds (something); hence: = state in which a round object has a certain measurable circumference
literally: (an activity) surrounds (someone); hence: = process by which humans undergo a certain activity in full measure
s.g: to be surrounded (with something); to happen in full measure

s.d: literally: to surround (someone with an an activity); hence: = causative process by which humans or deities cause (other) humans to undergo a certain activity in full measure
s.g: to surround (someone with something); to cause (something) to happen in full measure

s.d: literally: to surround; hence: = causative action by which humans or deities provide protection to (other) humans
s.g: to surround > to shield; to protect

s.d: literally: to go around; hence: = process by which an object is removed from its place and brought somewhere else
literally: to cause to go around; hence: = causative action by which humans cause an object to be removed from its place and brought somewhere else
state in which the boundary of an area changes direction and continues into a different direction
literally: to turn (one's) eyes; hence: = action by which humans look away from something they have been looking at before
literally: to turn (one's) face; hence: = action by which humans turn their face in a certain direction
s.g: to cause to turn around; to roll

s.d: literally: to turn; hence: = action by which deities change their minds about humans
literally: to turn (one's) heart; hence: = action by which humans decide to focus their thinking on something else
s.g: to turn (one's) heart; to put (one's) mind (on something else)

s.d: literally: to turn back (someone's) heart; hence: = causative action by which deities cause humans to change their way of thinking
s.g: to turn (someone's) heart back; to win back (someone's allegiance)

s.d: literally: to turn (someone's) heart; hence: = action by which deities cause humans to have a different opinion about other humans
s.g: to turn (someone's) heart; to change (someone's) disposition

s.d: iron framework; ◄ part of an altar or fire-place; ► location where objects are burned; ≈ associated with fire
